review: Cinq Don by far has the most niche and hardest playstyles in the game, while also having the least payoff for that playstyle ever. Yes, even moreso than Sunshower Heathcliff. Her overall clashes lean on the more average side of things while also having an extremely fast speed range. Unfortunately the entire playstyle is clashing with the enemy as often as possible while also being extremely fast, that in of itself being extremely inconsistent to the point where it's unreasonable because to reach her max potential in terms of dealing damage to the enemy, she must clash with the enemy 10 times at maximum which is very, very rng dependant.
